result.summary: The page is mostly coherent, but the first 'Popular right now' card has a failed/missing image (broken-image placeholder), its favorite button styling is inconsistent with the other card, and a restaurant name in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is hard-clipped without ellipsis. A few edge-clipping details also make the layout feel unfinished.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card in 'Popular right now' shows a gray broken-image placeholder instead of a restaurant photo, leaving a large empty block that looks unloaded/broken.
issues.suggestion: Add a proper fallback image or branded placeholder (e.g. cuisine illustration or logo with muted background) and verify the image URL/loading state; keep the badge and favorite button legible over the fallback.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) button on the broken-image card is a dark gray circle with a white outline heart, while the pizza card below uses a black circle. The inconsistent treatment plus low contrast against the light gray placeholder makes it look unstyled.
issues.suggestion: Use a single consistent favorite button style (same size, background opacity/scrim, icon color) across all cards, ensuring at least 3:1 contrast against any underlying image.

issues.description: 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is cut off mid-word with no ellipsis, and the whole third card is hard-clipped by the screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Apply text truncation with an ellipsis for card titles and add consistent carousel peek/gutter padding so the partially visible card is intentionally offset rather than sliced.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card is abruptly cut by the bottom tab bar with no visible spacing, making it appear that content is hidden behind the navigation.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset/padding equal to the tab bar height so scrollable content ends cleanly above the navigation.

issues.description: The category chip row ends with a sliver of a fifth chip at the right edge, which reads as a rendering glitch rather than a scrollable row.
issues.suggestion: Add trailing horizontal padding and/or a fade/scroll affordance so the row clearly indicates more categories are available.

issues.description: The notification bell's red unread dot is the only indicator of new alerts and relies on color alone, with no visible count or label.
issues.suggestion: Add a numeric badge and an accessible label such as 'Notifications, 1 unread' for screen readers.
